feed.title: Don’t Fall for Supermicro’s Margin Magic: The Company Already Said It’s Temporary
feed.summary: Supermicro's recent fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 report showed a non-GAAP gross margin of 17.6%, significantly beating expectations and causing shares to surge. feed.title: Jim Cramer Backs Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) While Target (NYSE: TGT) CEO Drives Surprising Retail Revival
